lines.zh: 翅膀扑闪扑闪，发出细微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Wings flap softly, making a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 翅膀闪烁着幽光，像夜空中最暗的星辰。
lines.en: Wings glow faintly, like the darkest star in the night sky.

lines.zh: 触须轻摆，寻找着食物的气味。
lines.en: Antennae sway, seeking out food scents.

lines.zh: 缓缓飞行，像是天际的幽灵。
lines.en: Floats slowly, like a ghost in the sky.

lines.zh: 翅膀在空中划出一道微弱的弧线。
lines.en: Wings trace a faint arc through the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻拍着，发出微弱的振动声。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly.

lines.zh: 在夜色中悄无声息地飘动。
lines.en: Drifts silently in the night.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻拍打，发出细微的声响。
lines.en: Wings tap softly.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，掠过月光。
lines.en: Wings vibrate gently, gliding over moonlight.

lines.zh: 飘动着，寻找着新的落脚点。
lines.en: Drifts, seeking a new resting place.
My wingtip brushes the island grass.
I fan my wings across the clouds.

lines.zh: 静静地停在空中，翅膀微微颤动。
lines.en: Pauses in the air, wings trembling lightly.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，似乎在积蓄力量。
lines.en: Wings vibrate gently, building up strength.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息，等待着黑夜的降临。
lines.en: Rests quietly, waiting for the night to fall.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻微振动，发出细微的声响。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, making a faint sound.
Rests quietly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，仿佛在低语。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, as if whispering.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息在一片叶子上。
lines.en: Rests quietly on a leaf.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，寻找着目标。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, seeking a target.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息，享受宁静的夜晚。
lines.en: Rests quietly, savoring the calm night.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息，翅膀微微颤动。
lines.en: Rests quietly, wings trembling lightly.
I stop on a mushroom-flower to sip dew.
Wings folded, I drift with the clouds.
Scale dust settles on the petals.
My antennae reach for the Aether's morning dew.

lines.zh: 突然转动触须，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Swivels antennae, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，寻找玩家。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, searching for the player.
Suddenly turns, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 触须快速摆动，锁定玩家。
lines.en: Antennae quickly sway, locking onto the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，锁定目标。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, locking on the target.

lines.zh: 触须迅速摆动，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Antennae swiftly sway, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，锁定玩家。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, locking onto the player.
Swivels antennae, staring at the player.
My wings miss a beat, watching you.

lines.zh: 它的复眼映出你的影子
lines.en: Its compound eyes mirror your shape.

lines.zh: 触须朝你的方向弯了弯
lines.en: Its antennae bend toward you.
It circles halfway around you.
The wing pattern turns your way.
It hovers, sizing you up.
Its shadow lands on your shoulder.
It smells the pollen on you.
It stares at the lantern on your belt.

lines.zh: 它的翅脉轻轻颤了一下
lines.en: A vein in its wing quivers once.
Wings are damaged, can't fly.
Wounded, weak.
Attacked, need rest.
Wings hurt, move slowly.
Wings are split, can't fly.
Wings are broken, flying weakly.
Wings hurt, hard to fly.
Wings are damaged, can't fly.
Wings hurt, tired.
My scales are gone and my wings feel heavy.

lines.zh: 它那闪耀的翅膀诱惑着你靠近。
lines.en: Its shimmering wings tempt you closer.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同夜的低语，引你深入。
lines.en: Its voice whispers like the night, drawing you in.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰，让你难以抗拒。
lines.en: Its antennae lightly touch, drawing you in.

lines.zh: 你被它的美丽所迷惑，不自觉地接近。
lines.en: You are entranced by its beauty, drawing near.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你感到既美丽又危险。
lines.en: Its presence is both beautiful and perilous.

lines.zh: 它的光芒让你分不清现实与幻觉。
lines.en: Its glow blurs the line between reality and illusion.

lines.zh: 你被它的神秘魅力所吸引。
lines.en: You are drawn by its mysterious charm.

lines.zh: 它的出现让你感到既好奇又恐惧。
lines.en: Its appearance stirs both curiosity and fear in you.

lines.zh: 你被它的美丽外表所欺骗。
lines.en: You are deceived by its beautiful appearance.

lines.zh: 它那令人着迷的光芒让你无法抗拒。
lines.en: Its mesmerizing light draws you in against your will.
You collide with its wings.
Its wings brush against you.
You collide with its antennae.

lines.zh: 它的触碰让你感到一阵眩晕。
lines.en: Its touch leaves you feeling dizzy.
You are pushed away by its antennae.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀撞击让你感到疼痛。
lines.en: The impact of its wings leaves you in pain.

lines.zh: 它优雅地避开你的碰撞。
lines.en: It elegantly avoids your collision.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞未能触碰到它。
lines.en: Your collision fails to reach it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀鳞粉蹭到你手上了。
lines.en: My wing dust rubbed off on your hand.

lines.zh: 你与它的触角轻微碰撞。
lines.en: You lightly collide with its antennae.
It is searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中轻轻拍动。
lines.en: Its wings gently flap in the air.
It emits a mating call.
Its antennae search for a mate.
It dances through the air.

lines.zh: 月光下我和另一对翅膀并排飞。
lines.en: Under the moon I fly beside another pair of wings.
It seeks its other half.

lines.zh: 它的低语声充满求偶欲望。
lines.en: Its whispers are filled with desire.
It searches for a life mate.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在月夜中闪烁。
lines.en: Its wings flash in the moonlit night.
Don't touch these wings — they shed dust.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你会遭到攻击。
lines.en: Don't get close, or you'll be attacked.
I'm the guardian of the heavens.

lines.zh: 你身上有我想要的东西。
lines.en: You have something I desire.
You taste good.
This is my territory.
You smell like my prey.
That dew on the petal is enough.
My wings let me fly.
You have the light I need.
I've found new prey.
This will be your end.
I'll enjoy this moment.

lines.zh: 天境的雾里，我的翅膀忽明忽暗。
lines.en: In the Aether mist, my wings blink in and out.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，盖住你眼前的路。
lines.en: My wings spread and cover the road ahead.
Eleven wings beating at once.
You'll be my dinner.

lines.zh: 十一片翅把这座岛围住了
lines.en: Eleven wings have this island ringed.
My eyes are on you.
You're my next target.
I spotted you through a gap in the clouds.
It drops lower to approach you.
Wings snap shut, and it dives.
It marks where you last stood.
You rustled the island grass.
It trails you through the flowers.
I'll make you feel pain.
Your fear will guide me.

lines.zh: 你将为你的无知付出代价。
lines.en: You'll pay for your ignorance.

lines.zh: 我的翅粉沾上你的皮肤，开始发痒。
lines.en: My wing dust settles on your skin and starts to itch.
I'll enjoy torturing you.
I'll make you want to die.

lines.zh: 你将为今日的遭遇后悔。
lines.en: You'll regret this.

lines.zh: 你拨开草丛，我就在那片叶背。
lines.en: You part the grass; I am on the leaf's underside.
You'll fall into my trap.
I'll make you suffer.
It slips behind you.
Its antennae aim at your nape.
It starts circling, round and round.
Powder from its wings showers you.
It spirals close to your ear.
It pins its shadow beneath your feet.
It counts every blink you make.
Scale dust fogs your sight.

lines.zh: 它挥动着触角，向你逼近！
lines.en: It swings its触角, closing in on you!

lines.zh: 它的翅膀带着寒意，贴脸而至！
lines.en: Its wings bring cold, brushing past your face!

lines.zh: 它的触须伸向你，仿佛要抓住你！
lines.en: Its feelers stretch toward you, as if to grab you!

lines.zh: 它用触角点触你的皮肤，冰冷刺骨！
lines.en: It touches your skin with its feelers, freezing cold!

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扑腾，发出轻微响声！
lines.en: Its wings flap, making a soft noise!

lines.zh: 它的触角缠绕住你的手臂，紧绷不已！
lines.en: Its feelers wrap around your arm, tightening!

lines.zh: 它贴着你的脖子，触角如针刺一般！
lines.en: It presses against your neck, feelers like needles!

lines.zh: 它试图用触角触碰你的眼睛！
lines.en: It tries to touch your eyes with its feelers!

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你耳边煽动，令人不安！
lines.en: Its wings flap near your ear, unsettling!

lines.zh: 触角缠绕脖颈，冰冷而有力！
lines.en: Feelers wrap around your neck, cold and strong!
A wing smacks your face.
Antennae jab into your collar.
It strikes your shoulder blade.
A wing edge rakes your hand.
It shoulders you aside.
Scale dust bursts into your eyes.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，它悄无声息地出现！
lines.en: It appears silently from the darkness!

lines.zh: 天空中，一只天境蝴蝶飞来！
lines.en: A sky butterfly flies in from the sky!

lines.zh: 它从裂缝中滑出，悄无声息！
lines.en: It slides out from the crack, silently!
It fades in and out in the sky!

lines.zh: 天际边，一只天境蝴蝶飞舞！
lines.en: A sky butterfly dances on the horizon!

lines.zh: 从天而降，天境蝴蝶出现！
lines.en: A sky butterfly descends from the sky!
It follows like a shadow in the dark!
A sky butterfly descends from the sky!
It flickers in and out of sight in the air!

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，悄然降临！
lines.en: It circles in the air, silently descending!

lines.zh: 从浮空岛的花丛里升起
lines.en: It rises from the island's flowers.
A speck of glow falls from the clouds.
It unfolds its wings between petals.
The Aether's breeze carries it in.
It takes shape out of the mist.
One lifts off at the island's edge.
It rides an updraft toward you.
It appeared while the dew still clung.
Burned by fire, extinguish!
Fell on wings, get up!
Drowned, swim out!
Explosion hurt, hide!
Hit by arrow, dodge!

lines.zh: 被魔法击中，快施法救我！
lines.en: Hit by magic, cast to save!

lines.zh: 饿得翅膀无力了，快找食物！
lines.en: Starved, weak from hunger, find food!

lines.zh: 被雷击中了，快找避雷处！
lines.en: Lightning hit, find shelter!
Fell into void, come back!
